messages:
maya: Heads-up — my docs PR #4823 preview is failing CI (linkcheck + vale). Can someone advise quick fix vs hold for full review?

maya: CI details: linkcheck -> 1 broken relative link in /docs/guides/migration.md, vale -> flagged 'weasel words' in the intro. Preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4823 (internal).

docs-ci-bot: Linkcheck: FAILED (1) — /docs/guides/migration.md -> ../api/overview.md not found.
docs-ci-bot: Vale: FAILED — rule 'weasel' at line 4: "simple and robust".

srini: If the link is just a bad relative path you can push a one-line path fix and re-run preview. What's the exact markdown?

maya: snippet: ```markdown
[See API overview](../api/overview.md)
```
Seems when the preview builds under /docs/guides the relative goes up one too many levels. I can change to `/docs/api/overview` or fix the relative to `../api/overview.md` -> `../../api/overview.md` depending on structure.

jen: I can take the vale fix. Which sentence tripped it?

maya: Vale message: "Avoid weasel words: 'simple', 'robust'". Sentence is: "This will make the migration simple and robust." Suggestion: "This helps simplify migration and improve reliability"

jen: OK I'll push the wording tweak as a tiny commit.

srini: Plan: maya fixes the path, jen fixes wording, push two commits so CI shows separate diffs. I'll queue a quick review once preview passes. @alex are you around to give final sign-off after CI?

alex: I can review this afternoon. If CI passes, I'm fine with merging into next deploy window.

maya: Pushed both fixes to branch `docs/migration-fix-4823` -> force-pushed. Re-running preview: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr/4823/build/5

docs-ci-bot: Re-run started.

(about 10m later)

docs-ci-bot: Preview build 5: ✅ Linkcheck: 0 errors. ✅ Vale: 0 errors. All checks green.

alex: :thumbsup: LGTM. Merge during morning deploy slot unless anyone objects.

jen: no objections, thanks for the quick turnaround.

maya: Thanks all — appreciate the fast help!
